response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT tr.tradekind AS tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT a.translink) AS n FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord x ON x.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader tr ON tr.tradereg = x.trdref GROUP BY tr.tradekind) SELECT tradekind, n AS distinct_transactions, CAST(n AS REAL) / SUM(n) OVER () AS share FROM t

assumptions.assumption: Trader types with a NULL tradekind are kept as their own group (NULL), and are included in the total used as the denominator.
The ratio is computed as a decimal fraction (0 to 1), not a percentage, and is not rounded.
